englishInstructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand and brace your trunk.
Raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height while keeping a soft bend in the elbows.
Lower the weights under control and repeat without using momentum.
Stand with the kettlebell in front of you, hinge at the hips, and grip it with one hand.
Hike the bell between your legs, then drive the hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let the bell return under control, keep the spine neutral, and repeat before changing sides.
Hold the barbell at the shoulders with the feet about hip-width apart.
Dip slightly through the knees and hips, then drive forcefully upward.
Use the leg drive to press the bar overhead, finish with locked arms, and lower it under control.
Lie on your side with the elbow directly below the shoulder and the legs extended.
Brace the trunk and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.
Hold without letting the hips rotate or sag, then lower under control.
Lie on your side with the legs extended and support your balance with the lower arm.
Lift the legs and upper body toward each other while contracting the side of the abdomen.
Pause briefly, then lower under control without rolling backward.
